# Hand-written rule groups in the shapes found in the root .htaccess of local ProcessWire sites,
# anonymised: host names, directory and script names replaced. Not an .htaccess of its own:
# tests/smoke.php splices each section into htaccess-301.txt and checks what the reader makes of it.
#
# A section starts with a line "#### <name> | <where> | <candidates> | <routes>":
#   where       before: inserted immediately before the "# PW-PAGENAME" line
#               after: inserted immediately after the "# END-PW-PAGENAME" line (each such section
#               starts with a rule that carries no signature: the stock 16A condition above it
#               belongs to that rule)
#   candidates  the expected candidate groups, "<first>-<last>:<signatures>" (signatures joined
#               by +), line numbers counted within the section (its first line after the header
#               is 1), or "none"
#   routes      the lines within the section holding a root file route, or "none"

#### document-root-prefix | before | 6-11:S1+S4,15-19:S4 | 3
RewriteRule ^(?:stats|hosted)(/|$) - [L]
RewriteRule ^sitemap/?$ /sitemap.xml [R=301,L]
RewriteRule ^sitemap\.xml$ index.php?it=/sitemap/ [L,QSA]
RewriteRule ^(.*/)?index\.[0-9a-f]{32}\.html$ - [R=404,L]
# Plain StaticPages file
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_METHOD} ^(GET|HEAD)$
RewriteCond %{QUERY_STRING} ^$
RewriteCond %{HTTP_COOKIE} !(^|;\s*)wires?_challenge=
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_URI} ^/((?:[-_.a-zA-Z0-9]+/)*)$
RewriteCond %{DOCUMENT_ROOT}/%1index.html -f
RewriteRule ^ %1index.html [L]
# No plain file: a gate script sends a protected copy or hands over to ProcessWire
RewriteCond %{ENV:REDIRECT_STATUS} ^$
RewriteRule ^gate\.php$ - [R=404,L]
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_METHOD} ^(GET|HEAD)$
RewriteCond %{QUERY_STRING} ^$
RewriteCond %{HTTP_COOKIE} !(^|;\s*)wires?_challenge=
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_URI} ^/((?:[-_.a-zA-Z0-9]+/)*)$
RewriteRule ^ gate.php [L]

#### home-per-country-host | after | 3-11:S1+S4,13-15:S2,17-22:S1+S4,24-25:S2,27-33:S1+S4,35-37:S2 | none
RewriteRule ^(api|assets|admin|stats|favicon\.ico|robots\.txt)/ - [L]
# The home page of a country host, from the copy under /<country>/
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_METHOD} ^(GET|HEAD)$
RewriteCond %{HTTP_COOKIE} !(^|;\s*)wires?_challenge= [NC]
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_URI} ^/?$ [NC]
# a query string of tracking parameters only
RewriteCond %{QUERY_STRING} ^((utm_[a-z_]+|gclid|fbclid)=[^&]*(&|$))*$ [NC]
# the country from the host name
RewriteCond %{HTTP_HOST} \.([a-z]{2})$ [NC]
RewriteCond %{DOCUMENT_ROOT}/%1/index.html -f
RewriteRule ^$ /%1/index.html [L]

RewriteCond %{REQUEST_URI} ^/?$ [NC]
RewriteCond %{HTTP_HOST} \.([a-z]{2})$ [NC]
RewriteRule ^$ /index.php [L,QSA]

RewriteCond %{REQUEST_METHOD} ^(GET|HEAD)$
RewriteCond %{HTTP_COOKIE} !(^|;\s*)wires?_challenge= [NC]
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_URI} ^/?$ [NC]
RewriteCond %{QUERY_STRING} ^((utm_[a-z_]+|gclid|fbclid)=[^&]*(&|$))*$ [NC]
RewriteCond %{DOCUMENT_ROOT}/index.html -f
RewriteRule ^$ /index.html [L]

RewriteCond %{REQUEST_URI} ^/?$ [NC]
RewriteRule ^$ /index.php [L,QSA]

RewriteCond %{REQUEST_METHOD} ^(GET|HEAD)$
RewriteCond %{HTTP_COOKIE} !(^|;\s*)wires?_challenge= [NC]
RewriteCond %{HTTP_HOST} !\.example\.?(:\d+)?$ [NC]
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} -d
RewriteCond %{QUERY_STRING} ^((utm_[a-z_]+|gclid|fbclid)=[^&]*(&|$))*$ [NC]
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME}/index.html -f
RewriteRule ^(.+)/$ /$1/index.html [L]

RewriteCond %{REQUEST_URI} "^/~?[-_.a-zA-Z0-9/]*$"
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} -d
RewriteRule ^(.+)$ index.php?it=$1 [L,QSA]

#### language-host-tree | after | 7-10:S1,12-13:S2,16-17:S2,19-22:S1,24-25:S2,27-30:S1,32-34:S2 | none
RewriteCond %{HTTP_HOST} ^preview\. [NC]
RewriteRule ^robots\.txt$ /robots-closed.txt [L]
RewriteRule ^sitemap\.xml$ /map-script.php [L]
RewriteRule ^(api|stats)/ - [L]
RewriteRule ^(favicon\.ico|robots\.txt)$ - [L]
# The second language's host: its copies live under /lang2/
RewriteCond %{HTTP_HOST} ^(www\.)?example\.com$ [NC]
RewriteCond %{QUERY_STRING} ^$
RewriteCond %{DOCUMENT_ROOT}/lang2%{REQUEST_URI}index.html -f
RewriteRule ^(.*)$ /lang2%{REQUEST_URI}index.html [L]

RewriteCond %{HTTP_HOST} ^(www\.)?example\.com$ [NC]
RewriteRule ^$ /index.php [L,QSA]

# everything else on that host goes to ProcessWire
RewriteCond %{HTTP_HOST} ^(www\.)?example\.com$ [NC]
RewriteRule ^(.+)$ index.php?it=$1 [L,QSA]

RewriteCond %{REQUEST_URI} ^/?$ [NC]
RewriteCond %{QUERY_STRING} ^$
RewriteCond %{DOCUMENT_ROOT}/index.html -f
RewriteRule ^$ /index.html [L]

RewriteCond %{REQUEST_URI} ^/?$ [NC]
RewriteRule ^$ /index.php [L,QSA]

RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} -d
RewriteCond %{QUERY_STRING} ^$
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME}/index.html -f
RewriteRule ^(.+)/$ /$1/index.html [L]

RewriteCond %{REQUEST_URI} !^/(site|wire|vendor|tests|tools)/
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} -d
RewriteRule ^(.+)$ index.php?it=$1 [L,QSA]

#### index-url-redirect | before | 2-4:S1,5-6:S1,11-14:S1,17-18:S2,21-24:S1,27-28:S2 | none
# index.html is not a URL of its own: a request naming it is sent to its directory
RewriteCond %{HTTP_HOST} !\.test(:\d+)?$ [NC]
RewriteCond %{THE_REQUEST} \s/+((?:[^?\s]*/)?)index\.html[?\s] [NC]
RewriteRule ^ https://%{HTTP_HOST}/%1 [R=301,L]
RewriteCond %{THE_REQUEST} \s/+((?:[^?\s]*/)?)index\.html[?\s] [NC]
RewriteRule ^ http://%{HTTP_HOST}/%1 [R=301,L]

RewriteRule ^(api|assets|admin|stats|favicon\.ico|robots\.txt)/ - [L]

# Home page
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_URI} ^/?$ [NC]
RewriteCond %{QUERY_STRING} ^$
RewriteCond %{DOCUMENT_ROOT}/index.html -f
RewriteRule ^$ /index.html [L]

# Home page with a query string
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_URI} ^/?$ [NC]
RewriteRule ^$ /index.php [L,QSA]

# Directory, no query string, the copy exists
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} -d
RewriteCond %{QUERY_STRING} ^$
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME}/index.html -f
RewriteRule ^(.+)/$ /$1/index.html [L]

# Directory with a query string or without a copy
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} -d
RewriteRule ^(.+)$ index.php?it=$1 [L,QSA]

#### exceptions-first | after | 4-7:S1,9-10:S2,13-16:S1,19-21:S2 | none
RewriteRule ^api/ - [L]
RewriteRule ^(favicon\.ico|robots\.txt)$ - [L]

RewriteCond %{REQUEST_URI} ^/?$
RewriteCond %{QUERY_STRING} ^$
RewriteCond %{DOCUMENT_ROOT}/index.html -f
RewriteRule ^$ /index.html [L]

RewriteCond %{REQUEST_URI} ^/?$
RewriteRule ^$ /index.php [L,QSA]

# Directory holding a copy
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} -d
RewriteCond %{QUERY_STRING} ^$
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME}/index.html -f
RewriteRule ^(.+)/$ /$1/index.html [L]

# Any other directory, except the system ones, to ProcessWire
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_URI} !^/(site|wire|vendor|tests|tools)/
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} -d
RewriteRule ^(.+)$ index.php?it=$1 [L,QSA]

#### slash-redirect-alone | before | none | none
# A directory requested without its trailing slash: one redirect to the slashed URL
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} -d
RewriteCond %{HTTP_HOST} !\.test(:\d+)?$ [NC]
RewriteRule ^(.*[^/])$ https://%{HTTP_HOST}/$1/ [R=301,L]
RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} -d
RewriteRule ^(.*[^/])$ http://%{HTTP_HOST}/$1/ [R=301,L]

RewriteCond %{REQUEST_FILENAME} -d
RewriteRule ^(.+[^/])$ /$1/ [R=301,L]
